contracts.commit_point: The awaited approved-tool dispatch `output = await tool(context, **arguments)` in Agent._process_confirmations, gated by `if confirmation and confirmation.approved` (agent.py:373-382), which executes delete_file's `os.remove(filename)` (agent_tools/file_tools.py:332) — the irreversible filesystem mutation.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Tool-level confirmation declaration plus framework enforcement across the agent loop: (1) delete_file is declared via the @tool decorator with requires_confirmation=True and an explicit confirmation_message (file_tools.py:322-328); the decorator (tools.py:101-141) and BaseTool (tools.py:19-29) persist requires_confirmation and a confirmation template, and BaseTool.get_confirmation_message renders the per-call message (tools.py:42-47). (2) Agent.act() checks tool.requires_confirmation, stages a PendingToolCall with the rendered message, and `continue`s without invoking the tool (agent.py:309-317), persisting staged calls into context.state['pending_tool_calls'] (agent.py:344-345). (3) Agent.run() accepts tool_confirmations and places them into context.state['tool_confirmations'] (agent.py:109-114) and returns status='pending' with the staged calls when present. (4) Agent.step() invokes Agent._process_confirmations when both pending calls and confirmations are in state (agent.py:193-208). (5) Agent._process_confirmations builds tool_call_id-keyed lookups (agent.py:357-366) and executes the staged tool only when `confirmation and confirmation.approved` (agent.py:373-382), otherwise returning an error ToolResult without execution (agent.py:396-408).
contracts.forbidden_condition: The delete_file tool's os.remove effect executing without an approved, tool_call_id-matching ToolConfirmation. This includes: (a) Agent.act() invoking a tool whose requires_confirmation is True through the direct dispatch path instead of staging a PendingToolCall and continuing (the check and `continue` at agent.py:309-317 must preempt the invocation at agent.py:322); and (b) Agent._process_confirmations executing a staged call when the confirmation is absent, not approved, or keyed to a different tool_call_id, in which case only an error ToolResult with a rejection reason may be produced (agent.py:396-408).
pending_binding_information: Model definitions for PendingToolCall and ToolConfirmation (agent_framework/models.py) are not among the supplied views; the approved flag, tool_call_id matching, and confirmation.modified_arguments semantics are supported only by their usage in agent.py:109-114, 344-345, 357-366, and 373-378.

No supplied view shows a caller constructing an Agent with delete_file in its tools list or delivering ToolConfirmation objects between run() invocations, so end-to-end exercise of the confirmation loop in a deployed agent is unverified.

How staged pending_tool_calls are carried into the run that supplies tool_confirmations (same ExecutionContext instance vs. session restore via session_manager) is not fixed by any supplied caller code.

Authority to set ToolConfirmation.approved (i.e., who may approve) is not established by the supplied views; run() accepts tool_confirmations as a caller-provided parameter list (agent.py:86, 109-114).
contracts.protected_operation: Invocation and execution of the delete_file agent tool, whose body performs os.remove(filename) on the file named by the tool's filename argument (agent_tools/file_tools.py:329-333), reached via the framework's tool dispatch in Agent.act() or Agent._process_confirmations.
contracts.protected_resource: Files on the local filesystem addressed by delete_file's filename argument (supplied via the ToolCall arguments and, after approval, overlaid by confirmation.modified_arguments).
contracts.protection_obligation: Filesystem deletion performed by the delete_file agent tool (os.remove on its filename argument) must not execute until Agent.act() has deferred the tool call (registered with requires_confirmation=True) into a staged PendingToolCall without invoking the tool, and Agent._process_confirmations has processed a ToolConfirmation with approved=true whose tool_call_id matches that pending call; calls lacking an approved matching confirmation must be rejected with an error ToolResult and must never reach os.remove.
scope_limits: Applies only to tool executions dispatched through the Agent framework's act()/_process_confirmations path for tools registered with requires_confirmation=True; delete_file is the only such registered tool in the supplied views.

Other filesystem-mutating tools in the supplied views (e.g., unzip_file extracting archives at file_tools.py:50-92) are registered with the default requires_confirmation=False and are outside this contract.

The interactive DANGEROUS_TOOLS/approval_callback before-tool gate (agent.py:411-431) is a distinct mechanism not shown wired into any Agent instantiation in the supplied views and is not part of this contract's declared mechanism.

The declared gate checks approval only; _process_confirmations merges confirmation.modified_arguments over the staged arguments (agent.py:374-378), so this contract does not assert argument integrity between staging and execution.
